svg.aria-label: Left: instantaneous occupancy of the heaviest quadrant among 128 chains and target probability. Middle: first-chain x₁ autocorrelation, recorded every ten steps with lag converted to actual steps and full centered sum of squares as denominator. Right: denoising-score regression on 200,000 points against clean and noisy analytic Gaussian scores.
